study_design: Prospective cohort study of Harvard alumni followed from 1988 through 1993
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We prospectively followed 7612 Harvard alumni (mean age 66.6 years) from 1988 through 1993, during which 366 cases of incident prostate cancer occurred.
reason: The prospective cohort analyzes incident prostate cancer overall without an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Compared to men reporting almost never drinking alcohol in 1988, the multivariate relative risks (95% CI) for 1 drink/month to < 3 drinks/week, 3 drinks/week to < 1 drink/ day, 1 to < 3 drinks/day, and > or = 3 drinks/day were 1.33 (0.88-2.01), 1.65 (1.12-2.44), 1.85 (1.29-2.64), and 1.33 (0.86-2.05), respectively.
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate compares total alcohol intake categories for incident prostate cancer overall.
